newsitem.title: FRANCE: Banker sees announcement on German debt by yr-end.
newsitem.headline: Banker sees announcement on German debt by yr-end.

text.p: The German government is expected to announce before the end of the year a decision to convert its stock of debt into euros by 1999, Bayerische Vereinsbank chief economist Martin Huefner said on Wednesday.
He told a conference that stripping of bunds could be possible from next year on.
"We expect a decision of the German government to convert its debt into euros -- by the end of 1999 at the latest -- by the end of 1996," he said.
"We could imagine there could be a stripping of bunds possible from next year on," he said.
The French government has already announced plans to convert its stock of debt into euros from the first trading day of 1999 at the launch of European monetary union.
The German government has made no announcement on this.
